## TASK-012 - Distribute complete neutral assets to the registered Template

Update owning reusable guidance/contract inventories and Template test expectations, then use the existing template_update check/apply transaction for only Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project. Keep the ontology integration recipe in mapped reference assets and empty neutral canonical graphs; explicitly inventory each owner interface and specialization resource. Retain ordinary reference-collection mapping for the neutral recipe rather than adding active Template project instances. Stage coherent source edits with awareness of the existing watcher; handle any intermediate distribution only through its actual current check/lock/recovery results. Do not install or reconfigure the watcher.

### Risks

- Automatic watcher may distribute settled source edits; retain exact operation evidence and never edit generated Template files directly.

### Acceptance criteria

- Source-to-Template inventory covers every integration function, locator/recipe/competency resource, owner helper/role and session asset; omitted or incompatible resources fail checks.
- Template project identity and publication remain null/unbound, session disabled, runtime/services inactive and project-instance graphs empty; no backlog, memory records or native owner observations leak.
- All reusable changes originate in owning source collections; exact Template update and final check receipts are retained separately from root adoption.

### Planned verification

- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check, review exact source/target changes, apply the selected operation and rerun check.
- Run affected tests/test_template_update.py and Template contract tests; scan neutral assets for forbidden root/actor/runtime state and verify manifest closure.
- Assess full neutral completeness and rehearse deterministic specialization into a non-root fixture. Omitted recipe/owner/source resources, polluted root instance facts, enabled Template session, incompatible pins and changed locked core are rejection controls.
- Reopen final Template/source hashes and null identity, unbound publication, disabled session and empty graph values; compare original registry and all unselected project inventories.

## TASK-013 - Verify supported setup routes end to end

Run the changed initializer through actual setup operations in disposable copied depots with explicit source and work roots, then query installed destination ontology. Cover new create, first existing preparation, manual Template copy and selected prior initialized adoption, with historical/custom/disabled/recovery controls.

### Risks

- Disposable actual setup proves the supported route, not operation in an unspecified future customer project. No real child adoption occurs without its exact selection.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each supported compatible route returns both coherent project wiring and functional ontology queries with current destination source/version context.
- Historical fixtures identify reconstruction limits; ordinary reruns preserve recorded editions and opt-outs; negative cases fail exact integration checks without false healthy completion.
- Evidence records actual setup command/receipt/reopened files separately from fixture actor semantics and runtime not-exercised state.
- The matrix includes new create, authored first preparation, pristine unspecialized Template copy, prior initialized without Curator, prior Curator lacking semantics and already integrated refresh. Each compatible success answers every function/relationship/current-source competency using the destination helper.
- Original base editions and old source/adoption inventories remain immutable; include current disabled settings, missing ontology prerequisite, legacy role-layout refusal and compatible authored ontology. Unsupported/custom conflicts are exact non-ready outcomes, with no fabricated broad success.
- Each complete CLI route is observed in an explicitly selected disposable depot/work directory with reopened receipts, files and queries. This is end-to-end setup evidence for that fixture, distinct from a live owner session or real product adoption.

### Planned verification

- Set SYS4AI_CURATOR_TEST_SOURCE to the exact read-only depot and SYS4AI_CURATOR_TEST_WORK to a separate existing verification fixture directory, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONPATH to source initializer tests. Run python -m unittest test_curator_setup test_curator_session_setup test_curator_adoption test_curator_recovery test_static_readiness -v with .venv/bin/python.
- Run bounded capability/relationship/current-source query matrix in each created destination; inspect final no-duplicate/preservation manifests and setup receipt history.
- For each matrix row, compare full protected before/after inventories and semantic query identities; run file-only/missing-ontology controls, duplicate-free identical rerun, changed-source refusal and original-operation recovery.
